text:
aj: Heads up — noticed doubled billing events when requests fall back to the quantized variant. A few customers show 2x token counts on invoices. Anyone seen this before?

sahil: Yep, saw that. Proxy retries + fallback path seems to produce two meter events. example billing_event id=abc123 emitted twice.

billing-bot: Alert: detected 5 potential duplicate billing events in the last 30m. sample_ids: abc123, def456, ghi789.

irene: Are the duplicates exact duplicates or differing by route tags/metadata? If we had a consistent request_id/trace_id in the invoice event we could dedupe by (client_id, trace_id, route_variant).

maria: We currently don't include request_id on final invoice events — only session_id and fingerprint. that might be the root cause. :thinking_face: 

sam: Edge proxy replays when upstream 504s occur. it replays with X-Req-Attempt=2 but metering treats it as a fresh request because trace_id isn't propagated into the billing event.

aj: Proposal: add a canonical_event_id = sha256(client_id + trace_id + route_variant) and include route_origin: "fallback" | "primary" and route_version. Metering service would dedupe on canonical_event_id.

devex-bot: FYI: Console UX req — expose route_trace in invoice drilldown so finance can see when fallbacks happen. PM flagged this as P0 for transparency.

sahil: Implementation notes: need edge proxy to propagate trace_id for L7 fallbacks and update ingest schema. Draft schema snippet:```{
  "event_id": "string",
  "client_id": "string",
  "trace_id": "string",
  "route_variant": "string",
  "route_origin": "string",
  "attempt": "integer",
  "tokens": "integer"
}```

irene: Operationally we should plan a backfill: run a dedupe job for last 48h using canonical_event_id and emit credit adjustments. who owns the backfill?

maria: i'll own backfill with sam. we'll run in safe mode: only adjust when duplicates >1 and total duplicated tokens > 1000 to avoid noise.

aj: Cool. Next steps: sam+maria to ship schema PR + proxy change this week, add a feature flag to gate route_event emission until backfill completes, and billing team to validate sample adjustments. cc @billing.

(threads like this are intentionally short — followups will be in the PR and the billing audit ticket.)
